name: nagarro-presentation-studio
description: Nagarro Presentation Studio — build on-brand decks with AI, export to editable PowerPoint and PDF.

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.photos:caption: node tools/caption-photos.mjs
scripts.templates:check: npm run templates:index && npm run templates:validate
scripts.audit:dark: node tools/audit-dark-mode.mjs && node tools/audit-dark-mode.mjs --theme=light && node tools/audit-dark-vanish.mjs
